lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters are organized in a grid-like array posterior to the branchial region, forming approximately 9 vertical columns and 5 horizontal rows, with spot diameter increasing along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal axes at the centroids of the circular blobs, forming high-contrast nodes within a structured matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges extend across the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal-facing edges and shadows on the ventral-facing edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of faint, low-contrast high-luminance pixels is localized primarily within the lower half and posterior margin of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, white trailing filament is attached to the distal posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits exhibits a high-density cluster of non-uniform micro-spots, distinct from the organized grid pattern found on the flank.
